chunks: But those who believe and do good deeds We shall admit into gardens with streams of running water, where they will abide for ever, with fairest of companions and coolest of shades.
ai.seo_question: What are the specific rewards promised to believers who do good deeds in the Quran?
ai.summary: This verse, often cited in Shia exegesis as a comprehensive description of Jannah, emphasizes both physical comforts and spiritual purity, particularly the concept of 'azwaj mutahharah' (pure spouses) which signifies freedom from worldly defects. The promise of 'zillan zaleela' (profound shade) alludes to the relief from the intense heat of the Day of Resurrection, a key theme in eschatological discussions among scholars like Al-Tabarsi and Al-Tusi.
